_forum.scss and ResponsiveInterfaceTest: 44px forum controls, visible summary focus, readable media disclosures, reduced-motion and forced-colors contracts, non-color statuses, and WCAG AA critical color-pair assertions including the corrected 4.91:1 muted text pair; lang/en\|lt\|ru/forum_accessibility.php and LocalizationTest: complete key and placeholder parity for media, validation, transcript, caption, compatibility, and table text; ForumAccessibilityTest, ArchitectureComplianceTest, and ResponsiveInterfaceTest focused checkpoint: 28 tests and 22,936 assertions passed; dependency-free headless Chrome runner verified 1440x900, 375x812, and 320px reflow with one H1/main, no horizontal overflow, unnamed controls, duplicate IDs, missing image alternatives, invalid tables, undersized forum controls, or console errors; Tab exposed a visible skip-link focus ring; the browser completed administrator Livewire login, rendered media authoring controls, submitted an invalid topic form, observed focused assertive summary plus linked aria-invalid title error, and verified the authorized forum administration table caption and scoped headers; no schema migration or destructive data rewrite was introduced; existing topic IDs, URLs, answers, replies, reactions, subscriptions, bookmarks, reports, moderation history, and attachments remain under their existing relations |

| pet.interface.0004 | Pet profile and full lifecycle revision > 156 — dostupnost profilia dlia ekrannyx diktorov | vse blok i profilia dolzny imet logiceskie zagolovki i opisaniia | pet-interface | 24 | standard | implemented | verified | The additive pet migration expands the existing pet identity and adds five normalized tables with foreign keys, uniqueness, access-path indexes, optimistic versions, encrypted sensitive casts, and reversible down operations without rewriting legacy records; CreatePetProfile, PetProfileForm, and Livewire create: one private non-discoverable draft, explicit creator relationship, controlled broad species/unknown values, shared taxonomy link, stable key, creation idempotency, manager/privacy/alias creation, and actor-attributed evidence; PetProfileManager, PetManagerRole, PetProfilePermission, PetProfileAccess, policy, and invitation/revocation Actions: independent users, timed access, explicit grants/denials, server-side account/role/profile/action checks, immediate expiry/revocation, and separate critical permissions; PetProfileLifecycle and PetProfileStatus: sixteen typed states, transition validation, row and optimistic locking, state timestamps, critical-state locks, discovery side effects, idempotency, immutable actor event, and cache invalidation; PetProfileFact and RecordPetProfileFact: encrypted value/source/metadata, precision, source, author, verification, audience, immutable replacement chain, one current-key constraint, idempotent actor event, and stale-write rejection;
